en: An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a street scene with a prominent villa-style house on the left, surrounded by a fence and garden, and a row of multi‑storey residential buildings receding into the distance on the right. The foreground is an open, mostly bare plot of land or unpaved square. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the scene and publisher, including the town name and street. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century German urban landscape.
